g:HTMLPanel.p: Bootstrap's twelve-column flexbox grid: Container, Row and Column, with sizes, offsets and order per breakpoint.

d:Example.heading: Equal-width columns
d:Example.description: Columns without a number share the row equally: `XS_DEFAULT` writes `col`.

d:Example.heading: Sizes per breakpoint
d:Example.description: List several sizes, separated by spaces: these columns stack on phones and sit side by side from `md` up.

d:Example.heading: Row columns
d:Example.description: `RowCols` sets how many columns fit in a row, whatever the number of children.

d:Example.heading: Offsets and order
d:Example.description: `offset` pushes a column to the right; `order` changes where it shows, not where it is in the code.

d:Example.heading: Alignment
d:Example.description: `contentJustifyAlign` and `contentVerticalAlign` on a `Row` align its columns horizontally and vertically.

d:Example.heading: Containers
d:Example.description: A `Container` is fixed-width per breakpoint by default; `FLUID` takes the full width and `MD` is full width until `md`.
